result.summary: The OutOfMemory fix is in place, but the final release gate is blocked by a pre-existing test-isolation violation: `zig build test-env-verify` fails on C5 with a hardcoded UUID in tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig. issues.title: Hardcoded UUID violates test isolation in par02 integration suite
issues.description: zig build test-env-verify fails at C5 with [BLOCKER] T010 tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig:177 — hardcoded UUID `00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000ff` — generate per-test UUIDs instead.
issues.root_cause: The test fixture reuses a fixed UUID across isolated test cases, which violates the repository's test isolation contract and blocks the environment gate before the final PAR-02/PAR-03 acceptance run can proceed.
issues.fix_required: Remove the hardcoded UUID and generate a unique UUID per test case (or per test harness instance) before rerunning test-env-verify and the final release suite.

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV to fix the T010 UUID isolation violation in the par02 test fixture, then re-run the full release validation sequence.
